# Convex Clustering Examples

```{r}
per_cluster <- 30
num_solutions <- 9

set.seed(2)
X <- rbind(
  mvrnorm(per_cluster, c(1,1), matrix(c(1, 0.5, 0.5, 1), nrow=2)),
  mvrnorm(per_cluster, c(-2.25,1), matrix(c(0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75), nrow=2)),
  mvrnorm(per_cluster, c(0,-1.75), matrix(c(1.5, 0, 0, 0.25), nrow=2))
)

X <- t(X)

w <- kernel_weights(X, 0.5)
w <- knn_weights(w, 3, ncol(X))

gammas <- c(0.1, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 35, 50, 100)

solutions <- cvxclust_path_admm(X, w, gammas)

to_plot <- tibble(
  orig_x = numeric(),
  orig_y = numeric(),
  new_x = numeric(),
  new_y = numeric(),
  gamma = numeric(),
  index = numeric(),
  true_cluster = numeric(),
)

for(i in 1:num_solutions) {
  to_plot <- rbind(
    to_plot,
    tibble(
      orig_x = X[1,],
      orig_y = X[2,],
      new_x = solutions$U[[i]][1,],
      new_y = solutions$U[[i]][2,],
      gamma = rep(gammas[i], ncol(X)),
      index = 1:ncol(X),
      true_cluster = rep(c(1, 2, 3), times = 1, each = per_cluster),
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}

custom_labeller <- function(variable, value) {
  return(paste0("gamma=", value))
}

ggplot(to_plot) +
  geom_point(aes(orig_x, orig_y), alpha=0.25) +
  geom_segment(aes(group=index, x=orig_x, y=orig_y, xend=new_x, yend=new_y), 
               alpha=0.25, linetype=2) +
  geom_point(aes(new_x, new_y), color="blue") +
  facet_wrap(~gamma, labeller=custom_labeller) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )

```

```{r}
gammas <- seq(0, 100, 0.25)

num_solutions <- length(gammas)
solutions <- cvxclust_path_admm(X, w, gammas)

to_plot <- tibble(
  orig_x = numeric(),
  orig_y = numeric(),
  new_x = numeric(),
  new_y = numeric(),
  gamma = numeric(),
  index = numeric(),
  true_cluster = numeric(),
)

for(i in 1:num_solutions) {
  to_plot <- rbind(
    to_plot,
    tibble(
      orig_x = X[1,],
      orig_y = X[2,],
      new_x = solutions$U[[i]][1,],
      new_y = solutions$U[[i]][2,],
      gamma = rep(gammas[i], ncol(X)),
      index = 1:ncol(X),
      true_cluster = rep(c(1, 2, 3), times = 1, each = per_cluster),
    )
  )
}

```

```{r}
ggplot(to_plot) +
  geom_point(aes(orig_x, orig_y), alpha=0.15) +
  geom_path(aes(group=index, x=new_x, y=new_y, color=as.character(true_cluster)), 
               alpha=0.25, linetype=2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()

```

# Biclustering Example

```{r}
checker <- gen_checkerboard(300, 300, 10, 10, noise=1.5, shuffle = TRUE, prob_empty = 0.5, scale=FALSE)

ggplot(matrix_to_df2(checker$X), aes(x = order_col, y = order_row)) +
    geom_raster(aes(fill = value)) +
    scale_fill_gradient2() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

from_palm3 <- tune_bcbc(checker$X, model=palm, lambdas=c(0), gammas=2^seq(10, 15, 0.5), recalculate_weights = TRUE, progress = TRUE)

# devtools::install_github("nicolash2/ggdendroplot")

plot_fit(
    matrix_to_df(
        examplebcbc$U,
        weights = examplebcbc$w,
        labels = examplebcbcdata$row_partition,
        lambda = 0,
        cluster_with_weights = FALSE
    )
)

as_df <- matrix_to_df(
        examplebcbcdata$X,
        labels = examplebcbcdata$row_partition,
    )

colnames(examplebcbcdata$X) <- 1:ncol(examplebcbcdata$X)
rownames(examplebcbcdata$X) <- 1:nrow(examplebcbcdata$X)
row_dist <- as.matrix(dist(examplebcbcdata$X))
row_dist <- row_dist - min(row_dist[row_dist > 0])
diag(row_dist) <- 0 
col_dist <- as.matrix(t(dist(examplebcbcdata$X)))
col_dist <- col_dist - min(col_dist[col_dist > 0])
diag(col_dist) <- 0 
row_hclust <- hclust(as.dist(row_dist))
col_hclust <- hclust(as.dist(col_dist))

plot_fit(as_df) + 
  geom_dendro(row_hclust, pointing="side", xlim=c(500, 600)) +
  geom_dendro(col_hclust, xlim=c(0, 500), ylim=c(201, 241))
```

# Clustering Dimension

```{r}
set.seed(20)
check <- gen_checkerboard(100, 200, 4, 4, noise=2, p_extra=0, scale=FALSE)

all_checks <- list()
all_checks[[1]] <- cbind(check$X,
                         matrix(rnorm(100*100, sd=2), nrow=100))
for(i in 2:10) {
  all_checks[[i]] <- cbind(all_checks[[i-1]],
                           matrix(rnorm(100*100, sd=2), nrow=100))
}

plot_fit(matrix_to_df(check$X, check$row_partition)) / 
  plot_fit(matrix_to_df(all_checks[[1]], check$row_partition)) / 
  plot_fit(matrix_to_df(all_checks[[2]], check$row_partition)) /
  plot_fit(matrix_to_df(all_checks[[3]], check$row_partition)) /
  plot_fit(matrix_to_df(all_checks[[4]], check$row_partition))

check_sol <- palm(check$X, lambda = 0, gamma = 1000)
check_sol100 <- palm(all_checks[[1]], lambda = 0.055, gamma = 1500)
check_sol200 <- palm(all_checks[[2]], lambda = 0.075, gamma = 2000)
check_sol300 <- palm(all_checks[[3]], lambda = 0.090, gamma = 2500)
check_sol400 <- palm(all_checks[[4]], lambda = 0.100, gamma = 3000)

plot_fit(
  matrix_to_df(
    check_sol$U,
    weights = check_sol$w,
    labels = check$row_partition,
    lambda = 0,
    cluster_with_weights = FALSE
  )
) /
  plot_fit(
    matrix_to_df(
      check_sol100$U,
      weights = check_sol100$w,
      labels = check$row_partition,
      lambda = 0.055,
      cluster_with_weights = FALSE
    )
  ) /
  plot_fit(
    matrix_to_df(
      check_sol200$U,
      weights = check_sol200$w,
      labels = check$row_partition,
      lambda = 0.075,
      cluster_with_weights = FALSE
    )
  ) /
  plot_fit(
    matrix_to_df(
      check_sol300$U,
      weights = check_sol300$w,
      labels = check$row_partition,
      lambda = 0.090,
      cluster_with_weights = FALSE
    )
  ) /
  plot_fit(
    matrix_to_df(
      check_sol400$U,
      weights = check_sol400$w,
      labels = check$row_partition,
      lambda = 0.100,
      cluster_with_weights = FALSE
    )
  )
```



# PALM data

```{r}

num_iters = 20
x = rep(NA, num_iters)
x[1] = 0.1
x_grad = rep(0, num_iters)
y = rep(NA, num_iters)
y[1] = 0.15
y_grad = rep(0, num_iters)

prox <- function(input, nu, offset = 1) {
  if(input > offset + nu) {
    return(input - nu)
  } else if(input < nu - offset){
    return(input + nu)
  }
  return(offset)
}

for(i in 2:num_iters) {
  lip_y =  (y[i - 1] ^ 2 + 0.25)
  x_grad[i] = x[i - 1] -  2 * x[i - 1] * lip_y
  x[i] = prox(x_grad[i], 1)
  
  lip_x =  (x[i] ^ 2 + 0.25)
  y_grad[i] = y[i - 1] -  2 * y[i - 1] * lip_x
  y[i] = prox(y_grad[i], 1)
}

```



# Contour Plots

```{r}

biconvex_func2 <- function(x, y) {
  ((x ^ 2 + 2) * (y ^ 4 + 0.25) + abs(x-5) + abs(y-5))
}

biconvex_func <- function(x, y) {
  biconvex_func2(x/0.1, y/3.1)
}


coordinate_wise_minima <- function(fixed) {
  opt <- matrix(NA, nrow=length(fixed), ncol=2)
  for(i in seq_along(fixed)) {
    f <- function(x) {
      biconvex_func(x, fixed[i])
    }
    f2 <- function(y) {
      biconvex_func(fixed[i], y)
    }
    opt[i, 1] <- optim(1, f, method="Brent", lower=-10, upper=10)$par
    opt[i, 2] <- optim(1, f2, method="Brent", lower=-10, upper=10)$par
  }
  cbind(fixed, opt)
}

```


```{r}
xmin = -1
xmax = 1
ymin = xmin
ymax = xmax
x1 <- seq(xmin, xmax, 0.005)
x2 <- seq(ymin, ymax, 0.005)

minima_curves <- as.data.frame(coordinate_wise_minima(seq(min(xmin, ymin), max(xmax, ymax), 0.01)))

expand.grid(X1 = x1, X2 = x2) |>
  mutate(Z = biconvex_func(X1, X2)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_contour(aes(X1, X2, z = Z)) +
  geom_contour_filled(
    aes(X1, X2, z = Z),
    colour="black",
    bins=200,
    # breaks = c(
    #   seq(1.11, 1.2, 0.01),
    #   seq(1.25, 1.4, 0.05),
    #   seq(1.5, 2, .1)),
    # alpha=0.85
  ) +
  geom_path(data=minima_curves, mapping=aes(fixed, V3), color="cyan", linetype=1, linewidth=1.1) +
  geom_path(data=minima_curves, mapping=aes(V2, fixed), color="green", linetype=1, linewidth=1.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option="C") +
  guides(fill="none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(xmin, xmax, 0.25)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(ymin, ymax, 0.25)) + 
  xlab("x") + 
  ylab("y")
  # coord_cartesian(xlim=c(1.85, 2.05), ylim=c(0, 0.2))

```

```{r}
biconvex_func2 <- function(x, y) {
  ((x ^ 2 + 2) * (y ^ 4 + 0.1) + abs(x-2) + 3 * abs(y-2))
}

biconvex_func <- function(x, y) {
  biconvex_func2((x*10+abs(x)/30), y + abs(y)/4)
}

biconvex_func <- function(x, y) {
  biconvex_func2((3*x + x^2)*10, y*3 + y^2/5)
}

biconvex_func <- function(x, y) {
  biconvex_func2(x*5, y)
}

# [1] 5.705434
# [1] 0.1407357

minima_curves <- as.data.frame(coordinate_wise_minima(seq(min(xmin, ymin), max(xmax, ymax), 0.001)))
max(abs(diff(minima_curves[, 2]))) / 0.001
max(abs(diff(minima_curves[, 3]))) / 0.001

max(abs(diff(minima_curves[, 2]))) / 0.001 * max(abs(diff(minima_curves[, 3]))) / 0.001

```


# Real Data

## Leuk

```{r}
sparsebc_leuk <- readRDS("./sparsebc_leuk.RDS")
palm_leuk <- readRDS("./palm_leuk3.RDS")
# cobra_leuk <- readRDS("./cobra_3leuk.RDS")

leuk_y <- read.csv("./data/leukemia.y.txt", header = FALSE)
leuk <- t(read.csv("./data/leukemia.x.txt", header = FALSE, sep = " "))
leuk <- scale(leuk)
```

```{r}
leuk_dist <- dist(leuk)
leuk_dist_col <- dist(t(leuk))

cut_tree_leuk <-
  cutreeDynamic(hclust(leuk_dist),
                minClusterSize = 9,
                distM = as.matrix(leuk_dist))

cut_tree_leuk_col <-
  cutreeDynamic(hclust(leuk_dist_col),
                minClusterSize = 20,
                distM = as.matrix(leuk_dist_col))

igraph::compare(cut_tree_leuk,
                leuk_y$V1,
                method="adjusted.rand")

plot_fit(matrix_to_df(leuk, leuk_y$V1), "Gene Expression Pattern of Leukemia Samples")
```

```{r}

igraph::compare(palm_leuk$row_clusters[[157]],
                leuk_y$V1,
                method="adjusted.rand")

plot_fit(
  matrix_to_df(
    palm_leuk$all_runs[[157]]$U,
    leuk_y$V1,
    weights = palm_leuk$all_runs[[157]]$w,
    cluster_with_weights = TRUE
  ),
  "Biclustering of Leukemia Data (BCBC)"
)
```

```{r}

igraph::compare(sparsebc_leuk$Cs,
                leuk_y$V1,
                method="adjusted.rand")

plot_fit(matrix_to_df(sparsebc_leuk$mus,
                leuk_y$V1),
         "Biclustering of Leukemia Data (SparseBC)")
```

```{r}
igraph::compare(cobra_leuk$groups_col[[39]]$cluster,
                leuk_y$V1,
                method="adjusted.rand")

plot_fit(matrix_to_df(t(cobra_leuk$U[[39]]),
                leuk_y$V1),
         "Biclustering of Leukemia Data (COBRA)")

plot_fit(matrix_to_df(t(cobra_leuk$U[[39]]),
                leuk_y$V1,
                labels2 = cobra_leuk$groups_col[[39]]$cluster),
         "Biclustering of Leukemia Data (COBRA)")

```
